badges.line: You live on both sides of this one. Which side shows up depends on the moment.

halves.name: Old Soul
halves.desc: You love the cozy, familiar kind of life, you speak gently, and you still need hours alone behind your own door. Quiet is where you recharge.

axes.line: You love hard and keep your own door. Close still means space.
You hold the person first. The hard part waits for a gentler moment.
Traditions, rituals and the way a home should run feel like home to you.

halves.name: The Easygoer
halves.desc: You don't race anyone's timeline. You go with the flow, you like the flow familiar, and you're usually the calmest person in the room.

axes.line: Security first. Your leaps come with a safety net.
You run on your own clock. Other people's timelines are optional.
You read the room. Rules bend when a person needs them to.

stings: Some people read your need for quiet as distance. You've never quite explained that it isn't.
People mistake your calm for not caring. You just haven't found the thing worth rushing for yet.
hearts: Love with a little space is still deep love.
My life doesn't need a progress bar.

tags.name: Plays by the rules
tags.heart: Fair isn't cold to me. It's safe.
tags.sting: You trust the process, because you don't quite trust people to wing it.

youToldGenii.said: Guilty. Page 12. I had it bookmarked.
Zero. The syllabus doesn't read reviews.
"Buyer one was first. I'm really sorry."

tags.name: Classic at heart
tags.heart: I can hold new ideas and old wishes at the same time.
tags.sting: You're open-minded about everyone's setup, and a small part of you still wants the one you grew up with.

youToldGenii.said: Said "in this house, we..." and heard my parent's voice
Kept a rule from my childhood home, like shoes off
"Forever. I'm even keeping the tablecloth with the gravy stain."

tags.name: Logs off on time
tags.heart: A good life is the whole point, not the reward for later.
tags.sting: You've turned down a bigger role and slept great. Some people still can't figure you out.

youToldGenii.said: Didn't touch it. Future me handled it.
Never. My three loyal likers have never let me down.
Sleep through it. Every week. No regrets.

tags.name: Family gets a vote
tags.heart: My family is part of my 'we', and I like it that way.
tags.sting: Big decisions feel safer with a family nod, and waiting for it can slow a few of them down.

youToldGenii.said: Never. Anything that big, I'd run past them first.
"Okay. The truck's on hold until we all talk."
Unpack. I can't live under that face.

tags.name: Big family wedding
tags.heart: Thinking of my family is my own choice too.
tags.sting: You want the ceremony, and part of it is for the people who've waited years to see it.

youToldGenii.said: Posted a photo within the month. Official is official.
Our names, then send the photo to both families.
Robbed. I've had that toast ready for years.

calls.line: You've read the terms and conditions on something.
You still make the family recipe exactly as written.
You'll leave on time today and not think about work or school once.

plotTwist.line: You'd say: ‘Advocate. "The family with the baby gets one. Obviously."’ Last time, you did: ‘Guilty. Page 12. I had it bookmarked.’
